Physical Dimensions & Structural Layout • Inside Clear Height (ICH): 35' (thirty feet) • Inside Clear Width (ICW): 30' (thirty feet) • Structural Joinery: Flange in the top beam to facilitate transport, rapid assembly, and structural modularity. 2. Load, Travel, & Gradeability Specs • Lift Capacity: 180 ton or higher load capacity, speciﬁcally engineered to transport the designated heavy concrete target blocks that meet HHSTT speciﬁcations. • Gradeability: 3% or higher under full operational load. • Drive Conﬁguration: Closed-loop hydrostatic drive system paired with hydraulically driven All Wheel Steering (AWS) and All-Wheel Drive (AWD) for optimized maneuverability on compacted soils. 3. Mechanical, Hoisting, & Hydraulic Systems • Hoist System: 2-speed (dual range) hoists featuring a low-mounted, large-diameter grooved hoist drum to optimize spooling and minimize wire rope wear. • Hydra

hose covers to protect lines from mechanical abrasion and UV exposure. 4. Electrical, Lighting, & Instrumentation • Diagnostic Capabilities: Integrated remote diagnostics system with real-time hydraulic pump pressure and temperature monitoring. • Work Area Illumination: High-intensity DC-LED Work and Drive Lights. • Power Controls: Full-function Wireless Remote Control alongside primary cab controls. 5. Environmental, Cab, & Safety Features • Operator Cab: Enclosed, weather-sealed operator's compartment equipped with a heavy-duty HVAC heating and A/C unit. • Acoustics: Level 1 Sound Suppression system. • Alarms & Visual Warnings: Travel warning system consisting of four (4) directional travel alarms and high-visibility strobe lights. • Fire Safety: Integrated ﬁre extinguisher in the operator cab. • Emergency Isolation: Dedicated emergency stops located at each of the wheel frames. 6. Physical Dimensions & Structural Layout • Inside Clear Height (ICH): 35' (thirty feet) • Inside Clear Width (ICW): 30' (thirty feet) • Structural Joinery: Flange in the top beam to facilitate transport, rapid assembly, and structural modularity. 2. Load, Travel, & Gradeability Specs • Lift Capacity: 180 ton or higher load capacity, speciﬁcally engineered to transport the designated heavy concrete target blocks that meet HHSTT speciﬁcations. • Gradeability: 3% or higher under full operational load. • Drive Conﬁguration: Closed-loop hydrostatic drive system paired with hydraulically driven All Wheel Steering (AWS) and All-Wheel Drive (AWD) for optimized maneuverability on compacted soils. 3. Mechanical, Hoisting, & Hydraulic Systems • Hoist System: 2-speed (dual range) hoists featuring a low-mounted, large-diameter grooved hoist drum to optimize spooling and minimize wire rope wear. • Hydra

hose covers to protect lines from mechanical abrasion and UV exposure. 4. Electrical, Lighting, & Instrumentation • Diagnostic Capabilities: Integrated remote diagnostics system with real-time hydraulic pump pressure and temperature monitoring. • Work Area Illumination: High-intensity DC-LED Work and Drive Lights. • Power Controls: Full-function Wireless Remote Control alongside primary cab controls. 5. Environmental, Cab, & Safety Features • Operator Cab: Enclosed, weather-sealed operator's compartment equipped with a heavy-duty HVAC heating and A/C unit. • Acoustics: Level 1 Sound Suppression system. • Alarms & Visual Warnings: Travel warning system consisting of four (4) directional travel alarms and high-visibility strobe lights. • Fire Safety: Integrated ﬁre extinguisher in the operator cab. • Emergency Isolation: Dedicated emergency stops located at each of the wheel frames. 6.
